notes: New in 2.3.7: two things. 1) Reactions on WhatsApp (setting: Natural). When you ask it to do something, like a task, a search, a reminder or a site, it puts 👍 on your message as soon as it starts working, and changes it to ✅ when it is done. If it needs your YES first, the 👍 stays until you say YES and it is finished. Small talk usually gets no reaction (now and then a ❤️ or 😂). You can change this in Settings → Channels → WhatsApp Agent → Reactions. 2) Delete your sites. Open More → Projects & sites. Under "Sites" you see the sites it published: on your server, on Cloudflare, and on GitHub. Each one has a Delete button, and it asks "Are you sure?" first. For GitHub you get two buttons: "Turn off Pages" (the website goes offline, the files stay) and "Delete repo" (everything is deleted). It only shows GitHub repos that it made itself, never your other repos. If your GitHub or Cloudflare token is not allowed to delete, it tells you which permission to add. You can also ask in chat, like "take down my bakery site"; it asks for your YES first.
